original.target_description: Study 3: single versus mixed candy colors; between-subjects planned ANCOVA contrast on average grams poured per bowl, controlling practice-task grams.

n.quote: One hundred five participants completed this study
n.sample_role: Participants in the target between-subjects candy-pouring ANCOVA; final analytic N is not explicitly printed.
n.exclusions: The paper reports 105 participants and removal of one participant for pouring more than four standard deviations from the mean. This implies 104 retained participants, but the target test prints denominator df 99 and does not explicitly identify its final analytic sample size.

replication.target_description: Study 3: within-participant effect of variety of poured Smarties on amount poured; 144 participants, no exclusions. Selected poured-color contrast corresponding to original Study 3, rather than the distinct seen-color or numeric-estimation contrasts.

es.location: p. 13, Table 3, Study 3: Variety of poured candy / Pouring candy, d column

reported_success.quote: the replication of Redden and Hoch (2009) pouring studies failed to produce the hypothesized effect (Study 3)

notes:
Replication page locator p. 16 does not correspond to the acquired final publication (Study 3 results pp. 5–6; summary p. 13). Author-derived d = 0.057 is printed in Table 3; body prints dz = 0.029 for the same test. Authors state at p. 7 that the pouring-study replication failed.
Source follow-up: Published article; title and DOI match the assigned reference. Source text encodes equals as p and less-than as ! in statistical expressions. No conversion of the printed F statistic. Analytic N is left null: 105 recruited minus one documented exclusion implies 104 retained, but 104 is not printed as the target-test analytic sample and denominator df 99 remains unreconciled. Replication and reported_success are unassigned.
